target_reference.note: Current public point estimate is a whole-benchmark reference, not a per-task deterministic threshold.

stages.name: MECHANISM_AND_ADAPTER_PREFLIGHT
stages.requirement: Exact pinned Stirrup source, execution profile, and required Brain artifact tools available.

stages.name: CHEAP_CROSS_ARTIFACT_FALSIFICATION
stages.selection: Deterministically select a small public-GDPval subset from task IDs before reading prompts, spanning at least three different requested artifact classes when feasible.
stages.execute: Brain-owned Stirrup execution profile on approved zero-incremental cognition substrate.
stages.verify: Use task-permitted format checks plus available public automated grader or blind comparison only after outputs are frozen.
stages.decision: Any systemic harness/integration failure returns to route race or integration correction. Do not repair a graded task and count replay as fresh evidence.

stages.name: MATCHED_PROFESSIONAL_WORK_COMPARISON
stages.requirement: Use a sufficiently broad uncontaminated task sample and scoring protocol comparable enough to the Opus 5.5 target to support an equal-or-better claim.
